_comment: Copy to datasets.json (or point VIEWER_DATASETS at it). Order = order in the UI; the first entry is the default. A bare SPEAR entry inherits the built-in curated variable table. Any other ArrayLake repo is discovered automatically (groups, grid, levels, ensemble); list 'variables' to choose which of its variables to show.

datasets.title: ECDA reanalysis
datasets.subtitle: SPEAR c96 ECDA J11 · monthly
datasets.description: GFDL SPEAR ensemble coupled data assimilation, monthly means on a 1 x 1.25 deg grid

datasets.title: CEFI NWA12 hindcast
datasets.subtitle: MOM6-COBALT Northwest Atlantic · monthly 1993–2023
datasets.description: NOAA CEFI regional ocean hindcast (MOM6/COBALT, NWA12 ~1/12 deg grid), monthly means; regridded by the viewer to a regular 0.065 x 0.08 deg lat/lon grid (nearest neighbour)
